caption:
$196 per kW per month: North America's average wholesale colocation price, up from $148 in December 2023.

That is +32% in under three years, though the average has been flat since December 2025. The October release changed no prices but added 11 metros, taking the index to 23 markets with a $200 median.

The biggest yearly rise: Chicago, +14.7% to $215.

Data: Coloprice Colocation Index, 26 Oct 2026. Sources on the last slide.
